summary.prose: Building s2 means adding one small new type module to src/workflow/review-round/: the fixed five-category taxonomy every review finding is classified under, the Finding shape itself (id, category, severity), and a documented HIGH/MED fallback severity scale. There's no new logic or runtime behavior -- just types, a compile-time fixture proving the shape is closed and exact, and a matching named test suite.

tasks.title: Add FindingCategory, Finding and DEFAULT_SEVERITY_SCALE
tasks.summary: Add src/workflow/review-round/finding.ts exporting FindingCategory (fixed 5-member union), Finding {id, category, severity} (sc2's interfaceSketch as amended by HLD rev4), and DEFAULT_SEVERITY_SCALE = ['HIGH','MED'] as const, plus a compile-time typecheck fixture at __type-tests__/finding.typecheck.ts.
acceptanceChecks: FindingCategory, Finding and DEFAULT_SEVERITY_SCALE are exported exactly as dataModelChanges specifies, with no extra or missing field
the typecheck fixture rejects an invalid category literal and an added/removed Finding key via @ts-expect-error / Equal<keyof Finding,...>

tasks.summary: One it() per testStrategy.testLevels subject (6 total) in __tests__/finding.test.ts, matching ac1/ac2's acceptanceMapping.provingTests verbatim, exercising the compile-time fixture from t1.
acceptanceChecks: All 6 named test subjects from testStrategy.testLevels[0].subjects exist as individual it() cases with matching titles
ac1 and ac2's acceptanceMapping.provingTests all pass
npx tsx --test for the new test file passes with zero failures

tests.name: FindingCategory accepts exactly the five fixed categories (correctness, functional-completeness, security, quality, maintainability) and rejects any other category value at compile time
Finding.severity accepts any string value, including a review-type-specific custom severity scale outside HIGH/MED
DEFAULT_SEVERITY_SCALE names HIGH and MED as the documented fallback scale for a review type that declares none
Finding's exported shape contains exactly id, category and severity, and no other field of any kind
two Finding values with identical category and severity but different id values are distinct findings
